items.html: And behold, the matter of the ten Sefirot of Atzilut has been explained. And afterward, from these ten Sefirot of Atzilut they illuminated and brought out sparks, and they are the secret of the seal (Chotam), and they are called the ten Sefirot of Beria. And in the world of Beria too there are ten Sefirot, divided into Arich Anpin, Aba and Ima, and ZON of Beria, in the manner explained above in Atzilut — except that these are the seal of Atzilut, which spread from it. Afterward, from the power of these ten Sefirot of Beria they illuminated and brought out sparks, and they are called the ten Sefirot of Yetzira, and they are the aspect of the second seal, imprinted from Beria, which spreads from it. And these ten Sefirot too are divided into Arich Anpin, Aba and Ima, and ZON of Yetzira, in the aforementioned manner. And afterward, from the power of these ten Sefirot of Yetzira, the ten Sefirot of Assiya were imprinted, and they are a seal to those of Yetzira; and in this one too there is Arich Anpin, Aba and Ima, and ZON of Assiya, in the aforementioned manner. And behold, all these aforementioned Sefirot are all one complete Elohut (Godliness), from the beginning of the ten Sefirot of Atzilut to the end of the ten Sefirot of Assiya.
